pr_title: [Merged by Bors] - Replace VSync with PresentMode
pr_body:
# Objective

Enable the user to specify any presentation modes (including `Mailbox`).

Fixes #3807

## Solution

I've added a new `PresentMode` enum in `bevy_window` that mirrors the `wgpu` enum 1:1. Alternatively, I could add a new dependency on `wgpu-types` if that would be preferred.
pr_comments: Thanks. I agree with this approach, and the changes are perfectly fine. I'd like to try and find a more approachable naming convention ("Present" is extremely overloaded), but once that's cleaned up this LGTM.

Pull request successfully merged into main.

issue_context.title: Window and WindowDescriptor should specify present_mode instead of vsync
issue_context.body:
## What problem does this solve or what need does it fill?

Allow the user to control the present mode rather than interpreting it. A boolean value for `vsync` allows for two options where as the actual `PresentMode` has three: `Mailbox`, `Fifo`, and `Immediate`.

## What solution would you like?

Replace `vsync: bool` with `present_mode: wgpu::PresentMode` on `Window` and `WindowDescriptor`. 

## What alternative(s) have you considered?

There is currently no way to use `PresentMode::Mailbox`.

## Additional context

I'll submit a PR for the change if it's welcomed. I think the default should remain `Fifo` and documentation can be added to describe that `Fifo` represents `vsync = true`.
comments: Neat, this seems like a reasonable suggestion. I'm on board with this change, especially if it's accompanied by good docs.

review_comments: I'm not sure I love labelling these enum variants with numbers. What benefit does this serve?

To remain binary compatible with the `wgpu` struct. 

https://docs.rs/wgpu-types/0.12.0/src/wgpu_types/lib.rs.html#2632-2647
Makes sense. Could you please leave a comment in the code explaining this so it doesn't get carelessly reverted?
Oops, I missed this earlier. I've added a note here and pushed a new commit.
I'd put this comment on the enum itself instead of on this one variant within the enum.

I put it here so that it's in close proximity to the values. The concern was that someone might remove them erroneously, and having the comment right next to the value makes it rather impossible to miss.
I dont have a strong opinion here :)

New users are definitely going to be confused by this name.

Can we use `PresentationMode` instead? Are there any other more approachable synonyms?

This is the name used by `wgpu`. It seems that other wgpu items are used or mirrored directly, or given a `Wgpu` prefix.

https://docs.rs/wgpu-types/0.12.0/wgpu_types/enum.PresentMode.html

It's also the name of the corresponding Vulkan type:
https://www.khronos.org/registry/vulkan/specs/1.3-extensions/man/html/VkPresentModeKHR.html

I don't think a new user would be any less confused by the term `VSync`. I think it's preferable to keep the names aligned with the corresponding items in WGPU and the Vulkan spec. At least this way, googling for more information will be possible.
Could you add a doc alias to vsync to help transition, and maybe add a link in the doc comments to where its use, in `set_present_mode` and the `WindowDescriptor` struct?
